svg.title: Pranay Kadu — Code companion
svg.desc: BackendArchitectX. Backend Software Engineer working with Java, Spring Boot, Distributed Systems and AWS. A custom robot quickly types, projects three floating code tiles, assembles them into a module and sends the module into the terminal. The canvas, terminal and outer edges are transparent. Build for failure. Preserve the invariant.
